text: ... well packaged AND it was the size (small) and easy function and cheap microwave I wanted. Although it came well packaged AND it was the size (small) and easy function and cheap microwave I wanted, its door is out of alignment and won't shut properly.  After wiggling it and slamming it, I got it to work about 1 out of 5 times.  I have no patience for such a piece of garbage so back it goes tomorrow!  UPDATE:  Husband pointed out there is a large dent, NOT caused by us, on the corner of the door, which explains why it will not align.  It was packaged well, but came damaged as it turns out.  We did not drop it, hit it or abuse it in any way.  So they packaged and sent a dented item that does not work.
